en.headline: Three pinhole cameras found in Sha Tin 24/7 Fitness changing rooms
en.dek: Police classified the case as voyeurism after a member discovered devices taped to false ceilings at the Lek Yuen Street branch; no arrests yet.
body: Police are investigating the discovery of three pinhole cameras hidden in changing rooms at the 24/7 FITNESS gym on Lek Yuen Street in Sha Tin, after a male member reported the devices on Friday afternoon.

The man noticed a small glowing object taped with black adhesive tape above a false ceiling in one changing room around 5.11pm on 25 September. Staff removed it and found two more identical devices in other changing rooms. Police said the cameras’ wiring was connected to the false-ceiling light fittings.

Sha Tin district crime officers are handling the case, which has been classified as voyeurism. No one has been arrested. The gym said on social media that it reported the matter immediately and is cooperating fully with the investigation. The branch operator later checked three other nearby outlets and found no further devices.

zh.headline: 沙田24/7 FITNESS三更衣室發現針孔鏡頭 警列窺淫
zh.dek: 瀝源街分店周五下午有會員發現假天花藏有攝錄裝置，警方暫未有人被捕，交由沙田警區跟進。
body: 警方正調查沙田瀝源街24/7 FITNESS健身中心更衣室發現三個針孔攝錄鏡頭的案件，事主為一名男會員，於9月25日下午約5時11分報案。
該名會員發現其中一間更衣室假天花有用黑膠紙黏着並發光的物件，職員拆除後發現是針孔鏡頭，其後在另外兩間更衣室再發現同類裝置。警方表示，鏡頭電線接駁至假天花電燈線路。
案件列作窺淫，交由沙田警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫時未有人被捕。涉事分店在社交平台表示已即時報警並積極配合調查。分店負責人其後檢查同區另外三間分店，未再發現類似裝置。
